English Grammar: Articles (Notes & Tricks)

Articles kya hote hain?

Articles (A, An, The) aise words hain jo Noun (Sangya) se pehle aakar yeh batate hain ki Noun 'specific' (khaas) hai ya 'general' (aam).

Articles 2 type ke hote hain:
1. Indefinite (A, An): Kisi bhi aam (general) singular countable noun ke liye.
2. Definite (The): Kisi khaas (specific) ya nishchit noun ke liye.

🔥 Golden Tricks (Common Mistakes se bachne ke liye) - Part 1

1. Trick for 'A' vs 'An' (The Hindi Sound Rule):

Kabhi bhi English ke a, e, i, o, u vowels dekh kar 'An' na lagayein, hamesha word ki Hindi aawaz (Pronunciation) sunein:
• An: Wahan lagta hai jahan word ka pehla letter Hindi ke Swar (अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ, ए, ऐ, ओ, औ) ki aawaz de.
• A: Wahan lagta hai jahan word ka pehla letter Hindi ke Vyanjan (क, ख, ग... य, र, ल, व) ki aawaz de.

💡 Magic Examples (Confusing Words for A/An):

• An honest man ('h' silent hai, 'O-nest' ki aawaz aati hai).
• An MLA ('M' bolne par 'A' ki aawaz pehle aati hai: em-el-a).
• A university (Spelling 'u' se hai, par aawaz 'य/yu' ki aati hai).
• A one-rupee note (Spelling 'o' se hai, par aawaz 'व/wa' ki aati hai).

🔥 Golden Tricks - Part 2

2. Trick for 'The' (Definite Article):
'The' wahan lagta hai jahan hum kisi cheez ko highlight karte hain ya jo duniya mein fixed hai:
• Superlative Degree: Adjective ki sabse aakhiri degree ke pehle (e.g., The tallest boy, The best book).
• Unique Cheezein: Jo nature mein ek hi hain (e.g., The Sun, The Moon, The Earth).
• Famous Nouns: Pavitra kitabein, Nadiyan, Pahaad (e.g., The Ramayana, The Ganga).

💡 The Repeated Noun Rule:

Jab kisi aam cheez ka zikr sentence mein dobara ho, toh woh khaas ban jati hai aur 'The' lagta hai.

Example:
I saw a dog. The dog was barking.
(Pehli baar 'a', agli baar wahi dog specific ho gaya toh uske pehle 'The' lag gaya).

🚫 Zero Article (Kahan Article NAHI lagana hai) - Part 1:

Yeh trick bahut exams mein puchi jati hai:

• Bhasha (Languages) aur Subjects ke aage:
Galat: I speak the English.
Sahi: I speak English.

• Uncountable Nouns (Jinhe gina na ja sake): Milk, Gold, Water, Honesty.
Example: Gold is a precious metal. (The Gold nahi hoga).

🚫 Zero Article - Part 2:

• Desh ya Insaan ke naam ke aage (Proper Nouns):
Galat: The Rahul lives in the India.
Sahi: Rahul lives in India.

Exception: Jin countries ke naam mein United, Republic ya Kingdom aata hai, wahan lagta hai.
Jaise: The USA, The UK.
